data.one_liner: Dependency-free, type-safe Dart library for unit conversion.
data.what_it_does: Abstracts measurement units into type-safe types that can be interpreted and converted between any valid units of the same dimension. Provides arithmetic operations, comparisons, standard SI prefixes, and derived units.
use_when: You need type-safe unit conversions without risking domain logic errors
You want to decouple specific unit types from the rest of your code
You require calculations involving distance, mass, time, temperature, and other physical dimensions
avoid_when: You need external dependencies or databases to handle unit lookup configurations
You are dealing with domains completely unrelated to physical measurements or unit conversions
strengths: Compile-time type safety preventing nonsensical unit operations
Comprehensive built-in support for SI prefixes, dimensions, and derived units
weaknesses: Does not focus on performance micro-optimizations
Migration required when upgrading between major versions (such as 2.x to 3.x)
